name: presenter-ab
description: Issue #8, part B: the FLUID presenter with FIFO against IMMEDIATE (EDEN_NX2_PRESENT_MODE), frame generation off and on, fullscreen, with the presenter's pacing counters and EDEN_NX2_SHOWN_STATS's shown-interval lines in refreshes. Run one suite with Windows' hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling on and one with it off (a reboot between), and say which in the pull request: the log's 'Present setup' line names it. A surface without IMMEDIATE logs a warning and presents with FIFO, so its immediate rows equal fifo; say so. Look for tearing in the immediate runs. The settings keys follow the [Renderer] section of qt-config.ini: check them against your own after turning frame generation on once in the GUI.
